blog_title: DTF Film Cost Trap — ₹15 Cheap Film Cracked 300 T-Shirt Prints in 2 Washes
caption:
₹15 की film की बचत — 300 T-shirts का print 2 wash में crack 😬

We've seen this nightmare: ₹300 का printed tee, सिर्फ दो बार धोने से print फट गया। कारण? Sasti DTF film + half-baked curing.

300-400 pieces wasted. Business hit. Lesson? Quality film का कोई shortcut नहीं।

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for your printing business 👇
